verification.locale_parity: All 40 topic pairs have matching icon, ItemLink and Recipe sequences, and page-link target sequences.
verification.headings: Every body begins with a second-level heading. All English section headings contain at most 24 characters.
verification.punctuation: No English or Chinese semicolon remains.
verification.navigation: Every Markdown page link is on a standalone bullet. All original page-link targets are retained. All targets exist in both generated locale folders.
verification.item_names: Every instructional ItemIcon identifier has a matching localized ItemLink label and every ItemLink has an icon on its page. Existing grid identifiers are retained.
verification.processing_quantities: Wheat milling, raw iron crushing and crushed iron washing quantity and chance rows are unchanged. Native Recipe identifiers and sequence are unchanged for every topic and locale.
verification.syntax: GuideME 21.1.19 MdAst parser accepted a composite document containing all 80 revised locale bodies, with zero parse failures. Its malformed ItemLink negative control was rejected.
verification.runtime: No game launch, loaded registry inspection or visual rendering test was performed.

limitations: Static item models and language labels are not registration proof. Native ItemLink localization and layout still require parent integration and rendered review.
Backpacks! keeps component-bearing native Recipe outputs. No plain command-block or jigsaw icon was substituted for a backpack.
Illustrated shapes, colors and material families are representative. Shortened prose does not claim an exhaustive inventory. Full selected family inventories remain in existing evidence files.
Unsupported recipe types retain item visuals and exact output data instead of invented native Recipe displays.
Some industrial engine Ponder assembly and operation entries are themselves unfinished. The revised article preserves that limitation.
No live profile, game options, mods, worlds, authoritative content JSON, generator or generated resource pages were changed.
